skeptic.summary:
I couldn't spot-check anything. The session's web search budget was already used up (200 of 200), and every search I tried was refused. So this review rests on three things: the catalogue's own internal consistency, word counts on all 66 descriptions, and my own knowledge of Scepter's list. None of the flags below were confirmed by a search in this pass.

What I found:
- **Over-length descriptions:** none. All 66 are 22 words or fewer; the Daily Roman Missal one sits exactly at 22.
- **Other publishers (3):**
  - Searching for and Maintaining Peace is Alba House, not Scepter.
  - The Daily Roman Missal is Midwest Theological Forum.
  - Moments Divine is, I believe, a TAN Books reprint of Frederick A. Reuter.
- **Placeholder entries (5):** Divine Insights, A Man Who Knew How to Forgive, At God's Pace, Call Him Father and The Well of Life are recommended for dropping. Their only "description" is a sourcing note such as "author and publisher not confirmed", and nothing ties them to Scepter.
- **Sourcing notes in descriptions:** about 30 descriptions say where the book is sold ("sold in Australia by Veritatis", "listed by Freedom Publishing") instead of what it is about, or just repeat the title. I rewrote the ones where I could do it safely.
- **Wording:** "proven techniques" in The Challenge of Love and "abundantly… healthy understanding" in the children's confession guide are blurb language.
- **Inconsistent titles and names:**
  - The three Collected Letters entries use three different title formats.
  - "St" and "St." are mixed.
  - Josemaría is unaccented in two titles.
  - Two titles are mis-capitalised: "Go In Peace…To The" and "A Path To Sanctity".
  - Author fields carry "Fr" and "St." on only two entries.
- **Missing authors:** seven blank author fields for well-known Scepter books. I filled them from my own knowledge, not from a search, so check each against the publisher page before it goes on the site.
- **Duplicates:** none found.

Still unverified: whether Scepter published The Power of the Rosary (Gabriel Castillo), Visions of Purgatory, The Maiden of Nazareth, The Risen Jesus, Go in Peace, Home Again, Nine Days to Welcome Peace, He Calls, We Answer, Overcoming Lukewarmness, Through Wind and Waves, Beyond Good Intentions, My Russian Way, To Be a Man and Marriage: A Path to Sanctity. For Marriage: A Path to Sanctity I think the authors are Javier Abad and Eugenio Fenoy; for The Meaning of Vocation, John Paul II. I didn't apply either. Six descriptions only restate their title and need real content once a source page can be read: Overcoming Lukewarmness, Through Wind and Waves, Beyond Good Intentions, The Risen Jesus, Visions of Purgatory and My Russian Way. On the leads question, the catalogue doesn't show any Scepter Australia publisher; Scepter books reach Australia only through distributors.
